name: codekeeper-runtime
description: Provider-configurable Agents SDK runtime and deterministic GitHub maintainer policy

scripts.check: bash -c 'for file in src/*.mjs src/lib/*.mjs presets/*.mjs scripts/*.mjs evals/*.mjs evals/braintrust/*.mjs test/*.mjs audit/*.mjs; do node --check "$file"; done' && node scripts/generate-tooling-manifest.mjs --check && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/*.test.mjs audit/*.test.mjs evals/braintrust/*.test.mjs
